birth.note: Estimated from age at death (around 80 years old).

relation.note: Was bought by al-Muʾayyad Shaykh (cf. AIND-D03345) before his sultanate (اشتراه المؤيد قبل سلطنته).

event.note: Travelled with the detached troops (المجردون) to al-Jawn, shortly before his death in 861 H.

event.desc: Returned to Cairo sick after travelling with detached troops to al-Jawna.
event.note: Occurred upon returning from military expedition, leading to his death in the same year.

person.note: アズバク・アッ＝サムサマーニー・アル＝ムアイヤディー。スルタンとなる前のムアイヤドによって購入され、後にハーサキーとなり、アシュラフ・イーナールの時代には五人長（アミール・ハムサ）となった。アル＝ジャウンへ遠征隊と共に赴き、帰還した際に病を患い、861年ズー・アル＝ヒッジャ月にカイロで死去した。享年80歳前後。

Azbak al-Samsamānī al-Muʾayyadī was bought by al-Muʾayyad before his sultanate, then became a khāṣṣakī, and during the days of al-Ashraf Īnāl, he became an amir of five. He travelled with the detached troops to al-Jawna and returned sick, dying in Cairo in Dhū al-Ḥijja 861 H, at around eighty years of age.
